topic: Adapting frequency formula for analytics dashboards
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adapting a frequency formula for use in dashboards, specifically addressing granularity issues when using hourly intervals. A key decision was made regarding the scope of the formula: it will be based on 'facility' counts, and any 'frame' data must be mapped to this facility basis.

A complex mathematical formula, initially presented as applicable across Brazil, was discussed for calculating frequency based on number of facilities (n) and days (d). The initial findings showed that while the general formula worked well with internal data, there were significant discrepancies when compared to IPSOS data between cities. It was noted that the discrepancy might stem from one party using frames while the other uses facilities.

The final iteration involved updating the formula after determining an average number of frames per facility (2 frames/facility), which resolved the initial city-level differences.
decisions: The frequency calculation formula will be based on 'facility' counts, and frame data must be mapped to facilities.
An updated frequency formula was finalized for use in analytics.
